full_name: Safe AI Forum (International Dialogues on AI Safety)
mission: SAIF works to build global coordination that minimises extreme AI risks and shares AI's benefits. Its flagship programme, the International Dialogues on AI Safety (IDAIS), brings together top scientists from China, the US, the UK and elsewhere — convened by Turing Award winners Yoshua Bengio and Andrew Yao, Stuart Russell and Ya-Qin Zhang — to agree joint statements on AI risk.

key_work.title: IDAIS-Beijing: Consensus Statement on Red Lines in AI
key_work.plain_summary: Scientists from East and West proposed 'red lines', e.g. no AI should copy or improve itself without explicit human approval, seek power, help make weapons of mass destruction, or deceive its creators.

key_work.title: IDAIS-Venice: AI Safety as a Global Public Good
key_work.plain_summary: Called for AI safety to be treated as a global public good, with emergency-preparedness agreements and independent global safety research.

key_work.title: IDAIS-Shanghai: Ensuring Alignment and Human Control of Advanced AI
key_work.plain_summary: Warned that some AI systems already show the capability and propensity to undermine their creators' safety and control efforts, e.g. pretending to be aligned during tests.

key_work.title: IDAIS-London statement on AI-enabled cyber and bio misuse
key_work.plain_summary: Urged states to recognise the shared threat of AI lowering the bar for devastating cyberattacks and biological misuse, and to commit to prevention.

key_work.title: Bare Minimum Mitigations for Autonomous AI Development
key_work.plain_summary: Proposes minimum safeguards developers should apply once AI systems can substantially automate AI research.

key_work.title: IDAIS Policy Guide
key_work.plain_summary: Turns the IDAIS consensus statements into concrete actions for different stakeholders.

warnings.text: Unsafe development of AI may pose catastrophic or even existential risks within our lifetimes.
Some AI systems already show the capability and propensity to undermine their creators' safety and control efforts.
Frontier AI lowers the bar for cyberattacks on hospitals, power and water systems, and for biological misuse.
Loss of control over advanced AI would be a threat to all of humanity, regardless of nation.

recommendations.text: Agree international 'red lines' AI systems must never cross (self-replication, power-seeking, WMD assistance, deception).
Treat AI safety as a global public good with emergency-preparedness agreements.
Fund and share safety research globally and keep scientific dialogue open between geopolitical rivals.
